name: deepseek-harness-for-codex
description: Delegate coding work through a visible local DeepSeek Harness Web session and inspect the result from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Run and watch a local DeepSeek coding agent.
interface.longDescription: Codex starts the local DeepSeek Harness Web UI, returns a clickable live-session link, delegates a scoped coding task, and independently reviews the workspace changes.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start the local DeepSeek Harness Web UI without opening my browser, give me its clickable session link, delegate this coding task, then review and verify the result yourself.
